'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Alden Peterson DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alden Peterson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Username:''' -maul
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
